result.summary: Several layout and missing-element problems: content is clipped by the tab bar and screen edges, a header control has no visible icon, and a restaurant name is truncated mid-word.

issues.description: The second Popular right now card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and delivery details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area / tab-bar padding so list cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The top-right circular control is an empty pale circle with only a red badge—no avatar or icon—so it looks broken and is hard to identify.
issues.suggestion: Add a clear profile, cart, or notification icon and increase contrast against the white background.

issues.description: The third Fastest near you card is clipped at the screen edge and the name reads “Trattoria Piccol” mid-word with no ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Keep a peek of the next card for the carousel, but truncate titles with an ellipsis so names don’t cut off mid-letter.

issues.description: Category chips overflow the right edge (Healthy plus a partial next chip), which is expected for a scroller but looks abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Fade or inset the trailing chip so overflow reads as intentional horizontal scroll.
